messages:
Maya Patel: kicking off Q2 hosted serve scope scrub. We need definitive slices for chat streaming (resumable), embeddings latency, and rerank SLA. Goal: finalize owners + launch criteria by Friday EOD. Who has customer commitments to inform tradeoffs?

Jonah Reed: for resumable streaming, UX ask from Orion Labs: resume across disconnects with token-level continuity. That implies a resume_token + server-side KV for session offsets. Tradeoff: extra storage and complexity vs UX.

Priya Singh: embeddings ask from Zephyr Search: they want consistent p95 <= 60ms for single-vector queries. With current single-host configs we average 70-90ms depending on batch. Options: optimize hot-path caching, smaller embed model for short queries, or dedicated pinned capacity for them. Need sample traces to validate.

Carlos Ruiz: SDK work for resumable streams is straightforward once API surface is decided. Suggested API: POST /v1/chat/stream -> returns stream chunks + resume_token header. Resume flow: include resume_token in request to continue. I can scope SDK + examples to 1.5 sprints.

Lina Kim: Zephyr is open to dedicated if it buys consistency; Orion prefers hosted but will tolerate a short canary. BrightHouse (customer asking about rerank SLA) insists on explicit rollback and a fallback to their legacy ranker on error. That needs routing and deploy hooks.

Evan Ops: runtime changes needed: route-by-customer pinning and per-route autoscale profiles. Minimal infra ETA for pinned route: 2.5 weeks. Also need an observable for resume-token mismatch errors.

Jonah Reed: proposing slice definitions (draft):
- Embeddings: p95 latency target per small-query profile, caching + hot-model recommendation, cost impact <= 15% or flag for PM sign-off.
- Chat Streaming: resumable token semantics, server-side session ledger, SDK + docs, canary plan.
- Rerank SLA: dedicated routing, A/B canary, automatic fallback to legacy ranker on regressions.
Each slice needs owner, launch criteria, and a rollback plan.

Maya Patel: proposed launch criteria checklist (additions welcome):
- measurable p95/p99 latency targets with customer scenarios
- automated regression evals on representative prompt sets
- e2e load & canary tests with SLOs in staging
- SDK examples + quickstart docs published
- formal customer sign-off for canary windows
- documented rollback & fallback policy

Priya Singh: add cost-breakout in the acceptance criteria: expected RPU change and tail-cost impact. Any >20% RPU increase needs PM+infra approval. We'll run cost sims once we have model/config choices.

Carlos Ruiz: example request shape for resumable stream I'm proposing:
```
POST /v1/chat/stream
{
  "model": "rwd-chat-lite",
  "stream": true,
  "resume_token": "<optional>"
}
```
Server returns: chunked events and header `Resume-Token`. Resume semantics must be idempotent for repeated resume attempts.

Evan Ops: note: resumable sessions mean we need TTL + cleanup for session ledger to avoid unbounded storage. Recommend 24h TTL by default. Also telemetry on resumed vs fresh sessions.

Maya Patel: owners so far: Embeddings -> Priya Singh; Chat Streaming -> Jonah Reed (API) + Carlos Ruiz (SDK/docs); Rerank SLA -> Jonah Reed + Evan Ops. I'll create the board cards and link dependencies.

deploy-bot: created ticket RD-4102 "Q2 Serve: Embeddings latency initiative" assigned to Priya Singh - https://redwood.internal/rd/4102 :white_check_mark:

Jonah Reed: implementation note: if we choose quantized weights for a smaller model to hit 60ms we must include quality regression checks in the rollout. Fallback plan: route affected traffic to a non-quantized variant if quality drops >x% on evals.

Maya Patel: good point. Include a rollout template with canary steps and a `fallback_on_quality_drop` flag. Meeting Friday 09:30 to lock scope & acceptance criteria. Agenda: prioritize customer bets, list infra blockers, confirm owners, and sign-off on launch checklist. Please add outstanding risks in thread before EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
